session_read: Pre-market Friday, and the book has moved a lot since last checked -- not from price action (the US session hasn't opened) but from a full afternoon of your own trading Thursday that only reached this desk in pieces. The headline: Microsoft is a brand-new position, MRVL got cut more than half (12 to 5 shares) which genuinely cured its own risk-cap breach but left its cluster underweight instead, MKS Instruments is fully out, and Nebius went in and out the same afternoon for a real loss. Total book sits at $42k, P&L +5.3%, drawdown -6.3%. Two proposals retired themselves overnight for the right reasons -- Stage GOOGL because the Hyperscaler cluster it was meant to fill got filled by the MSFT/AMZN adds, and Trim MRVL because trimming further would now deepen a different, opposite problem in the same cluster. That second one was a real bug in how the desk reasons about cluster breaches, caught and fixed this run. Eleven of yesterday's trades are logged with exact fills but no rationale yet -- worth a conversation when there's time, not urgent enough to hold up this check.
